en: The postcard features two sides: one with handwritten Swedish text addressed to Herr Sven Persson in Hellefors, Laxstorp, Skåne, and the other with a black-and-white photograph showing an industrial or construction scene. The photo depicts several workers in period clothing amidst a large metal tube or pipe and scaffolding, indicating significant heavy industry or infrastructure construction, likely involving a power plant or similar project around the early 20th century.
